items.title: Reddit Stock Pops 11% on S&P 500 Inclusion Despite Google AI Traffic Concerns
items.summary: Reddit shares rose 11% on S&P 500 inclusion news, even as Google's AI Overviews pressure its search traffic.

items.title: Reddit Shares Surge on S&P 500 Inclusion Later This Month
items.summary: Reddit Inc. will join the S&P 500 next week as part of an off-cycle change, S&P Dow Jones Indices said Thursday, sending the social networking platform’s shares surging more than 10% after the bell.

items.title: RDDT Stock Jumps 11% After-Hours — What's Driving The Rally?
items.summary: Reddit Inc. will replace AvalonBay Communities Inc. (AVB) in the S&P 500 effective prior to the opening of trading on Tuesday, August 18.

items.title: Reddit Will Join the S&P 500. The Stock Jumps 11%.
items.summary: Reddit  will replace  AvalonBay Communities  before the opening of trading on Tuesday, according to S&P Dow Jones Indices, which oversees the index.  The change was prompted by  Equity Residential’s  coming acquisition of AvalonBay, a large owner of multifamily housing.

items.title: CEO Steve Huffman Once Said of Creating Reddit, ‘I Just Didn't Want To Look Stupid In Front Of My Parents’ — Now RDDT Stock is Joining the S&P 500 Index
items.summary: What Reddit stock’s addition to the S&P 500 index means for the stock and for RDDT investors.

items.title: Reddit Stock Jumps On S&P 500 News
items.summary: Reddit stock jumped late Thursday on news that the social media firm will join the S&P 500 index. Sun Communities will be added to the S&P MidCap 400.

items.title: AvalonBay, Equity Residential merger approved by shareholders
items.summary: After investors voted to endorse AVB’s acquisition of EQR, the REITs expect to close the mammoth transaction in August.

items.title: Apartment REITs Signal Recovery, but Lease Pricing Lags
items.summary: Apartment REITs show recovery, but new lease pricing stays uneven as coastal markets continue outperforming Sun Belt peers.
